title: Problem 06
markdown:
For positive integers $n$, let

$$
a_n = \frac{2^n}{2^{2n+1} - 2^{n+1} - 2^n + 1}.
$$

Show that

$$
a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_{2017} < 1.
$$

### Solution (adapted from the official solution)
#### Substitution

Set $t = 2^n$. Then

$$
\begin{aligned}
2^{2n+1} - 2^{n+1} - 2^n + 1
&= 2t^2 - 3t + 1 \\
&= (2t - 1)(t - 1).
\end{aligned}
$$

Hence

$$
a_n = \frac{t}{(2t - 1)(t - 1)}
    = \frac{1}{t - 1} - \frac{1}{2t - 1}.
$$

Substituting $t = 2^n$ back gives

$$
a_n = \frac{1}{2^n - 1} - \frac{1}{2^{n+1} - 1}.
$$

#### Telescoping

$$
\begin{aligned}
\sum_{n=1}^{2017} a_n
&= \sum_{n=1}^{2017}
   \left(\frac{1}{2^n - 1} - \frac{1}{2^{n+1} - 1}\right) \\
&= 1 - \frac{1}{2^{2018} - 1}.
\end{aligned}
$$

#### Final Proof

$$
\frac{1}{2^{2018} - 1} > 0,
$$

so

$$
\therefore\quad 1 - \frac{1}{2^{2018} - 1} < 1.
$$

### Conceptual Explanation
The denominator factors as $(2^n - 1)(2^{n+1} - 1)$. Partial fractions give

$$
a_n = \frac{1}{2^n - 1} - \frac{1}{2^{n+1} - 1}.
$$

Adjacent terms cancel, leaving a sum strictly less than $1$.

### Key Technique
Partial fraction decomposition followed by a [telescoping sum](#node/node-telescoping-technique/sec-telescoping-core).
